A cultural reference, not a forecast.

trang_ts.nam.cach_tinh: How to work out your Personal Year
trang_ts.nam.cach_tinh_doan: Add your birth day + birth month (Gregorian calendar) + the year you are looking at, then reduce to a single digit 1–9. For example, born on 24 October, in 2026: 2+4 + 1+0 + 2+0+2+6 = 17 → 1+7 = 8, so Personal Year 8. Personal Years run in a 9-year cycle and change on your birthday or at the start of the calendar year, depending on the school.

trang_ts.nn.khi_nao: When a karmic debt is said to be present
trang_ts.nn.khi_nao_doan: When one of your main numbers (Life Path, Expression, Soul Urge, Personality, Birthday) passes through a total of {so} before reducing to {goc}. For example, if you were born on the {so}th, your Birthday number carries karmic debt {so}/{goc}.
trang_ts.nn.hieu_doan: Tradition calls it a 'karmic debt', but it is better read as a recurring lesson to practise, not a punishment or a bad omen. Nobody's life is settled by a number.
